t2.title: Social media making young people more anxious or more connected
t2.prompt: A student magazine announced an article writing contest. The best ones will be published in the magazine. Write your article on this topic: "Is social media making young people more anxious or more connected?" Write 180–200 words, giving reasons and examples.
t2.sample:
The Future of Education: Online vs Traditional Learning

The rapid growth of online learning has sparked debate about whether it could eventually replace traditional classroom education. While technology has undoubtedly transformed how we learn, I believe both methods will continue to coexist.

Firstly, online learning offers unparalleled flexibility. Students can access materials anytime and learn at their own pace. For working professionals or those in remote areas, this accessibility is invaluable.

However, traditional classrooms provide social interaction that online platforms struggle to replicate. Face-to-face discussions, group projects, and immediate feedback from teachers enhance learning in ways that virtual environments cannot fully match.

Moreover, certain subjects like laboratory sciences or performing arts fundamentally require hands-on experience.

Ultimately, I believe hybrid learning models combining both approaches will become the new standard. This would offer students the best of both worlds – the flexibility of online learning with the interpersonal benefits of classroom education.

t2.sampleB2:
Scrolling Ourselves Lonely?

Ask any teenager to hand over their phone for a day, and you'll likely be met with a look of pure horror. Social media has become the beating heart of young people's lives — but is it bringing us closer together, or quietly winding us up? On the bright side, these platforms keep us connected like never before. A quick message can bridge thousands of miles, and shy students who struggle to speak up in class often find their voice online. During lockdowns, group chats and late-night video calls were a lifeline for many of my friends, keeping loneliness at bay. That said, there's a darker side we can't ignore. Scrolling through everyone's picture-perfect posts, it's all too easy to feel that your own life falls short. The constant buzz of notifications and the pressure to reply the second a message lands can leave teenagers frazzled and anxious. So which is it? In my view, social media is neither hero nor villain — it simply amplifies what we bring to it. Used wisely, it connects us; used carelessly, it drains us. The trick is knowing when to switch off.
t2.uzSample:
Ta'limning kelajagi: Onlayn va an'anaviy ta'lim

Onlayn ta'limning tez sur'atlar bilan o'sishi uning oxir-oqibat an'anaviy sinf ta'limini almashtira olishi haqida bahs-munozaralarga sabab bo'ldi. Texnologiya o'rganish usulimizni shubhasiz o'zgartirgan bo'lsa-da, menimcha, ikkala usul ham birga yashashda davom etadi.

Birinchidan, onlayn ta'lim misli ko'rilmagan moslashuvchanlikni taklif etadi. Talabalar materiallarga istalgan vaqtda kirishlari va o'z tezliklarida o'rganishlari mumkin. Ishlaydigan mutaxassislar yoki chekka hududlarda yashovchilar uchun bu qulaylik juda qimmatlidir.

Biroq, an'anaviy sinflar onlayn platformalar takrorlashga qiynaladigan ijtimoiy muloqotni ta'minlaydi. Yuzma-yuz muhokamalar, guruh loyihalari va o'qituvchilarning tezkor fikr-mulohazalari virtual muhit to'liq mos kelolmaydigan tarzda o'rganishni yaxshilaydi.

Bundan tashqari, laboratoriya fanlari yoki sahna san'ati kabi ayrim fanlar tubdan amaliy tajribani talab qiladi.

Yakuniy xulosa qilib aytganda, menimcha, ikkala yondashuvni birlashtirgan gibrid ta'lim modellari yangi standartga aylanadi. Bu talabalarga ikkala dunyoning eng yaxshi tomonlarini - onlayn ta'limning moslashuvchanligini sinf ta'limining shaxslararo afzalliklari bilan birga taqdim etadi.

Salom Platforma Jamoasi,
Platforma menga yoqadi. U menga o'qishga yordam beradi. U oson. Men ko'proq videolarni xohlayman. Xayr.
t2.uzSampleA2:
Hurmatli Platforma Jamoasi,

Platforma uchun rahmat. U menga o'qishlarimda yordam beradi, chunki menga kerakli barcha ma'lumotlarni topa olaman. Menga videolar yoqadi, lekin ba'zida ular juda uzun bo'ladi.

O'ylaymanki, siz ko'proq testlar qo'shishingiz kerak, chunki ular menga o'rganishga yordam beradi. Shuningdek, forum ham yaxshi bo'lardi, chunki men savollar berishim mumkin. Platformada ba'zi narsalarni topish qiyin, lekin bu yaxshi.

Rahmat,
Shohruh Rahimov
t2.uzSampleB1:
Hurmatli Platformani Rivojlantirish Jamoasi,

Men sizga onlayn ta'lim platformasi haqida ba'zi fikr-mulohazalarimni bildirish uchun yozyapman. Umuman olganda, menimcha, u o'qishlarim uchun foydali bo'ldi. Menga ayniqsa barcha kurs materiallarining bir joyda bo'lishi yoqadi. Bu ko'plab kitoblarni olib yurishdan ancha osonroq.

Biroq, men qidiruv funksiyasidan foydalanish biroz qiyin ekanligini aniqladim. Ba'zan aynan nimani qidirayotganimni topish qiyin. Shuningdek, agar siz talabalar bir-birlariga savol berishlari mumkin bo'lgan funksiyani qo'shsangiz, juda yaxshi bo'lardi deb o'ylayman. Forum yoki chat xonasi juda foydali bo'lardi.

Menimcha, platforma yaxshi vosita, lekin uni bir nechta yaxshilanishlar bilan yanada yaxshiroq qilish mumkin. Fikr-mulohazalarimizni so'raganingiz uchun rahmat.

Hurmat bilan,
Shohruh Rahimov
t2.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli Platformani Rivojlantirish Jamoasi,

Umid qilamanki, ushbu xat sizga yaxshi yetib borgan. Sizning so'rovingizga binoan, men ushbu semestrda onlayn ta'lim platformasidan foydalanish tajribam haqida fikr-mulohazalarimni bildirish uchun yozyapman. Umuman olganda, platformani o'qishlarimda qimmatli vosita deb topdim, garchi takomillashtirish mumkin bo'lgan sohalar mavjud.

Platformaning eng foydali jihatlaridan biri uning qulayligidir. Ma'ruzalar va resurslarga istalgan vaqtda kirish imkoniyati, ayniqsa, boshqa majburiyatlarni boshqarishda juda foydali bo'ldi. Biroq, foydalanuvchi interfeysi ba'zan biroz tushunarsiz bo'lib tuyuldi. Turli modullar o'rtasida harakatlanishni soddalashtirish mumkin va yanada keng qamrovli qidiruv funksiyasi juda qadrlanadi.

Yangi funksiyalarga kelsak, men integratsiyalashgan munozara forumlari yoki virtual o'quv guruhlari kabi hamkorlik vositalarini qo'shish o'quv jarayonini sezilarli darajada yaxshilaydi, deb hisoblayman. Bu jamoatchilik tuyg'usini kuchaytiradi va talabalarga bir-biridan o'rganishga imkon beradi. Bundan tashqari, o'quv modullari ichida viktorinalar yoki simulyatsiyalar kabi interaktiv elementlarni kiritish ishtirokni va bilimni saqlashni oshirishi mumkin.

Fikr-mulohazalarimni ko'rib chiqqaningiz uchun tashakkur. Ishonamanki, ushbu yaxshilanishlar bilan platforma yanada samarali o'quv vositasiga aylanish potentsialiga ega.

Hurmat bilan,
Shohruh Rahimov

t12.title: formal letter · to platform development team
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the Platform Development Team. Share your experience and suggest improvements.
t12.sample:
Dear Development Team,

Thank you for seeking student feedback. I am pleased to share my experience with your online learning platform.

Firstly, the video lectures have been exceptionally helpful. The ability to pause and replay content has significantly improved my understanding of complex topics.

However, I have found the discussion forums somewhat difficult to navigate. A notification system would help students stay updated on replies.

Additionally, I would suggest developing a mobile application. This would allow students to access materials on the go, making learning more flexible.

Furthermore, adding progress tracking features could help students monitor their learning journey.

Thank you for your commitment to improving the platform.

Best regards,
A Dedicated Student

The video lectures have been a lifesaver, as being able to pause and replay them helped me get to grips with tricky topics at my own pace. However, the discussion forums are rather hard to navigate, and I often miss replies to my posts. Going forward, I would strongly recommend adding a dedicated mobile app so that we can keep up with coursework on the go. A notification system for deadlines and forum replies would also come in handy. Thank you for taking our views on board. I am confident these changes would make the platform even more effective. Yours faithfully, Bekzod Aliyev

Ko'plab talabalar, shu jumladan men ham, kurs materiallariga kirish va muhokamalarda yo'lda qatnashish imkoniyatidan foyda ko'rishardi. E'lonlar va topshiriq muddatlari uchun push-bildirishnoma tizimi ham juda qimmatli bo'lardi.

Takliflarimni ko'rib chiqayotganingiz uchun tashakkur. Ishonamanki, ushbu o'zgarishlarni amalga oshirish platformaning foydalanish imkoniyatini va samaradorligini sezilarli darajada oshiradi.

Hurmat bilan,
Talaba
